task.text: `Patient.discharge()` calls billing, housekeeping and the pharmacy itself.
Make the patient record a fact and let the departments react. `Ward(Billing, Housekeeping, Pharmacy)`, `admit(id, bed)` and `discharge(id)` keep working exactly as before.

items: `Patient(String id, String bedId)` keeps `discharge()` and `isDischarged()` and gains `pullEvents()`, which returns the recorded events once and then clears them.
Add `EventBus` with `<E> void on(Class<E>, Consumer<E>)` and `void publish(List<?>)`, routing by the event's class.
`Ward` subscribes the three departments in the order billing, housekeeping, pharmacy, and publishes what the patient recorded.

checks.title: Discharge still reaches billing, housekeeping and pharmacy
A second discharge is rejected with no side effects
Discharging one patient leaves others alone
PatientDischarged is a record with the facts
Patient records the event and nothing else

hints.text: Separate what happened from who cares. The patient can state the fact ("discharged") without knowing a single department. Someone else delivers that fact to whoever listens.

`Patient` appends a `PatientDischarged` to a list and hands it out in `pullEvents()`. `EventBus` keeps handlers per event class. `Ward` registers one handler per department in its constructor and publishes after `patient.discharge()`.
